summary: Sony Group Corporation filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign-private-issuer current report) disclosing grants of restricted stock units under its existing stock compensation plan. The Twenty-Fourth Series covers 13 recipients—2 subsidiary directors/officers (up to 111,140 shares) and 11 subsidiary employees (up to 154,130 shares)—for up to 265,270 shares, vesting on the first day of the month following the third anniversary, subject to continued service and Compensation Committee discretion. The Twenty-Fifth Series covers 408 Company employees plus 59 subsidiary directors/officers. This is a routine equity-compensation award, not a special situation; no transaction terms or advisors are involved.
